info.name: Creatio API
info.description:
This collection of Creatio API requests lets you test integrations with Creatio via OData 3 and OData 4. This collection lets you:

  • authorize external requests using AuthService.svc web service that implements forms authentication
  • authorize external requests using OAuth 2.0 to retrieve Creatio data securely
  • work with stream data
  • execute batch requests
  • set up filtering

To test requests to the Creatio via ways, download the environment via the following link.
